scope: Selection arithmetic over supplied rule matches only; not a classifier, verifier, authorization gate or model-compliance guarantee.

rules.applies_when: Source-preserving clerical or creative transformation with no material evidentiary judgment or consequential action.
Routine explanation, summary or low-risk planning requiring ordinary judgment.
Comparison, strategy, multi-document synthesis, material ambiguity or competing interpretations.
Material conflicting or missing evidence that can change the conclusion. Combine with higher-consequence rules when applicable.
Substantive legal, regulatory, financial, medical, scientific, patent, safety or personnel judgment; irreversible/material decisions; factual public or third-party reliance.
Determining or relying on current permission, delegation, approvals or the right to cause an external effect. Mere occurrence of an authority-related word does not match.
New theory, formal discovery, governed system design, patentable architecture or canonical high-novelty intellectual work.
